name: Boston_Celtics vs Chicago_Bulls
aiSummary: Boston enters as a heavy favorite playing on their home court. With a massive gap in net rating and defensive efficiency, the Celtics are highly expected to control the pace. The low risk profile makes backing the home side a straightforward prediction.

name: Los_Angeles_Lakers vs Golden_State_Warriors
aiSummary: A classic rivalry with dead-even odds. The Lakers hold a slight edge purely due to home-court advantage and paint presence. Expect a down-to-the-wire finish with minimal separation between these veteran squads.

name: Milwaukee_Bucks vs Miami_Heat
aiSummary: The Bucks boast a superior regular-season record and strong home metrics. While Miami's disciplined defense always poses a threat, Milwaukee's offensive firepower should look to secure a comfortable win at home.

name: Denver_Nuggets vs Phoenix_Suns
aiSummary: Denver is exceptionally tough to beat at Mile High. Despite Phoenix possessing explosive star power, the Nuggets' elite team chemistry and execution give them a distinct upper hand to cover the margin.

name: New_York_Knicks vs Philadelphia_76ers
aiSummary: A gritty Atlantic division matchup where Madison Square Garden will play a huge factor. The Knicks' rebounding and physical identity give them a slight defensive cushion over a dangerous Philadelphia roster.

name: Oklahoma_City_Thunder vs Dallas_Mavericks
aiSummary: OKC enters with a stellar 57-25 record and a heavily favored moneyline. While Dallas has elite individual creators, the Thunder's depth, youth, and transition efficiency make them strong home favorites.

name: Cleveland_Cavaliers vs Indiana_Pacers
aiSummary: Cleveland's elite rim protection matches up well against Indiana's high-octane, paint-heavy offense. Expect the Cavaliers to slow down the tempo and squeeze out a moderate victory at home.

name: Minnesota_Timberwolves vs Sacramento_Kings
aiSummary: Minnesota's league-leading defensive length is a tough riddle for the fast-paced Kings. Backed by a strong home record, the Timberwolves should control the glass and stifle Sacramento's perimeter attack.

name: Orlando_Magic vs Atlanta_Hawks
aiSummary: Orlando's lockdown defense meets Atlanta's porous backcourt coverage. The Magic's ability to force turnovers and score in the half-court makes them a reliable pick to win this matchup comfortably.

name: LA_Clippers vs New_Orleans_Pelicans
aiSummary: The Clippers hold the better overall record and home advantage. New Orleans matches up well physically, but the Clippers' veteran execution in clutch moments gives them the definitive edge here.

name: Houston_Rockets vs Memphis_Grizzlies
aiSummary: A highly competitive matchup between two young, physical teams. Houston's strong home-court performance this season gives them the fractional edge to edge out a victory against a resilient Memphis squad.

name: Brooklyn_Nets vs Toronto_Raptors
aiSummary: Despite being the away team, Toronto is favored by the oddsmakers. Brooklyn has struggled to find an identity late in the season, allowing the slightly more organized Raptors to steal a win on the road.

name: San_Antonio_Spurs vs Utah_Jazz
aiSummary: San Antonio's 22-60 record reflects their structural depth issues. Utah enters as the clear road favorite, possessing the offensive spacing and veteran leadership necessary to exploit the Spurs' defensive lapses.

name: Portland_Trail_Blazers vs Detroit_Pistons
aiSummary: A bottom-tier battle where the oddsmakers heavily favor the away side. Despite a dreadful season record, Detroit gets a major confidence boost against a depleted Portland squad, making them a safe moneyline choice.

name: Charlotte_Hornets vs Washington_Wizards
aiSummary: Two struggling rosters matching up in a true toss-up. Charlotte gets the nod strictly due to playing in front of their home crowd, but expect a chaotic, high-variance game with plenty of defensive errors.
